_about: Basil L. Gildersleeve (1831-1924), Johns Hopkins Hellenist: essays, lectures and his Syntax of Classical Greek (with C. W. E. Miller, part I, 1900). His school Latin grammar and readers, and The Creed of the Old South, are not taken. Also raw IA: Pindar, the Olympian and Pythian Odes, with an introductory essay, notes and indexes (American Book Company; copyright 1885, a later printing), Greek text with English commentary, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling.

gildersleeve-essays-studies-1890: Essays and Studies, Educational and Literary (1890)
gildersleeve-hellas-hesperia-1909: Hellas and Hesperia, or The Vitality of Greek Studies in America (1909)
gildersleeve-syntax-classical-greek-1900: Syntax of Classical Greek from Homer to Demosthenes, part I (1900), with C. W. E. Miller
gildersleeve-pindar-olympian-pythian-188: Pindar, the Olympian and Pythian Odes, with an introductory essay, notes and indexes (New York, Cincinnati, Chicago: American Book Company; copyright 1885, this copy a later printing, 1890 per IA); Greek text with English commentary, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling
